shots.vo: Saturday night. The district is closed for the weekend.
shots.shot: Night street of the diamond district (S23 set, wet, sodium + cool light, empty). FAST low drone push along the street toward the Diamond Centre entrance/garage mouth: start ~0.6 m above the wet setts, bollards whip past close to lens (motion blur), end rising slightly onto the building entrance. Feels like speed, not a slow pan.

FPV dive down the stairwell to Level -2 (door set stair + grate): camera rushes down the flight just above the steps, slight roll into the turn, torch beams ahead; at the bottom the grate stands open and the crew (Monster + Speedy from lib/cast.py) are walking away from camera through it toward the door (CMU walk via lib/mocap.py, '02','02_01'). Lights: stairwell batten + antechamber on.

Low tracking shot behind the four crew walking up to the vault door (mocap walk), torch beams sweeping the door; camera low (0.5 m) moving forward faster than them, slipping between Monster and Speedy.

shots.vo: a custom aluminium plate goes over the magnets, holding the two halves together.
shots.shot: existing macro, with post field lines

shots.vo: The door moves. The field never breaks.
shots.shot: Over the Monster's shoulder: King of Keys hauls the handle, the 3-ton door starts to swing toward camera, warm vault light spills across the crew; camera pushes in and arcs.
A2 key macro; render frames 60-130 only

REVERSE from inside the vault (vault=True): the door swings open toward camera's left, the crew silhouetted in the doorway, torch beams flare into the lens through thin haze; camera inside the vault dollies back fast revealing the box walls either side.

shots.vo: They don't try seventeen thousand combinations. They force them, with a custom hand-cranked device.
shots.shot: The Monster (lib/cast.py) at the box wall cranking a custom hand-cranked forcing device clamped on one box (simple steel frame + crank handle + screw); the crank turns, the box door buckles and pops open. Handheld close camera pushing in; sparks/dust optional; vault lights on.

shots.vo: One box. Then ten. Then fifty. A hundred and nine.
shots.shot: Accelerating wave: camera rushes down the vault aisle as box doors burst open in sequence along the walls, slow at first (one... ten) then a cascade (fifty... 109), contents spilling; motion blur; end on the wall of 109 open boxes. Count overlay added in the edit.
